prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the scene to correct; images 2 and 3 are the exact construction dehumidifiers and image 4 the exact industrial axial fan identity. Preserve the room architecture, two floors, stairs, railings, windows, natural light and 3:2 landscape framing of image 1. REPLACE ALL equipment, including upstairs. Exactly four dehumidifiers and four fans: one pair at each of the four existing positions. Dryers must have the stocky deep rectangular white cabinet of references, broad black filter front above a black collection bucket, full-depth white side panel with recessed handle orange switch and round control in correct locations, two black wheels, black tubular trolley wrapping down both sides and full floor base. No thin narrow tower, no stretched body, no mirrored control layout. Put foreground machines in three-quarter FRONT view to show cabinet breadth and depth. Fans MUST be substantial deep industrial units, not flat panels: circular white drum approx 30cm DEEP behind circular black grille approx 50cm diameter, visible full cylindrical sidewall, real rear motor assembly recessed inside, sturdy black U-shaped tubular tilting floor cradle extending front-to-back with both contact rails on floor. Front square white mounting face and Vernast branding match image 4. Rotate foreground fans 30-40 degrees relative camera so SIDE DEPTH is unmistakable; keep fan plane nearly vertical, tilt upwards at most 10 degrees. Upstairs fans also deep drums with full bases. Preserve sensible human scale dryer trolley about 1m tall, fans about 60cm tall. Natural varied orientations, physically grounded contact shadows, subtle operating blade blur behind SHARP protective grilles. Photoreal documentary equipment photo, realistic materials, no CGI sheen, no added text or graphic overlays. Do not change or flatten equipment proportions to fit.

Edit only the DOWNSTAIRS RIGHT WHITE DEHUMIDIFIER in this photograph. Its control panel is incorrectly mirrored. Remove that dryer entirely and replace it with an exact identical unmirrored copy of the DOWNSTAIRS LEFT dryer already in the image, scaled slightly smaller because farther away, at the original right dryer position. Both downstairs dryers must face EXACTLY THE SAME DIRECTION: white controls face on the LEFT, black filter on the RIGHT of each body. Duplicate the left dryer's orientation faithfully, do not flip horizontally. Keep all other pixels and equipment visually unchanged: room, 4 fans with deep drums, upper-floor machines, stairs, lighting. The new right dryer must have its black filter visibly on the RIGHT and white controls visibly on the LEFT exactly like the left dryer. Photorealistic 3:2.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is edit target, images 2 and 3 exact dryer identity, image 4 exact fan identity. Preserve existing room, window, plaster walls, doorway, lighting, camera framing and two small condensate pumps and their green gravity hoses. Replace both dryers with EXACT stocky deep rectangular cabinets of reference, no tall narrow stretched towers. Black filter FRONT above lower bucket cavity, broad white LEFT side with recessed handhold, orange switch and round control, black sturdy tubular trolley wraps each side down to ground, two wheels; no mirrored or invented controls. Dryers approx 1 metre tall including handles, 50cm wide, substantial depth. Keep lower bucket bays EMPTY, correctly routed small green hoses from drain inside bay down into existing small pump next to each machine, no buckets, pumps stay small and unobtrusive. Replace both fans with exact industrial axial fan: circular white cylindrical DRUM approx 30cm deep behind 50cm diameter black grille, visibly deep white SIDEWALL, recessed motor, square white mounting face, substantial black tubular U floor cradle with full length front-back contact rails. Rotate foreground fan 35 degrees toward left so full side depth visibly projects behind front grille; rear fan 30 degrees toward right, also visible thickness. Not a thin square panel, not pedestal fan, no paper-thin blades or flattened casings. White Vernast branding matches product references and stays consistent. Fan face near vertical, modest 5 degree upward tilt, subtle blade motion behind sharp grille. Four equipment units total: exactly two dryers two fans plus two small pumps. Realistic documentary photography natural proportions no CGI smoothness, grounded shadows. Landscape 3:2.
